pages.title: What Goes in the Pot
pages.text: The Alchemy Pot brews Gensokyo's flora: ghost fire, dream and demonic miasma mushroom caps, star flowers and flame cattails, plus vanilla staples like blaze powder, gunpowder, spider eyes and rotten flesh.

$(bold)Gathering$()$(br)Star flowers and flame cattails grow as wild plants, and the three mushroom kinds grow from their huge mushroom trees. Pick the caps and keep a mixed stock: almost every brew combines two or more of them.$(br2)Every recipe also names its fluid base (water or an earlier brew) and its brew time. The full list is visible in JEI under Alchemy Pot.
